links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to oral cancer patient questions versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All models produced responses above the recommended sixth-grade level; mean FKGL ranged from 12.65 ± 3.07 (ChatGPT-5) to 15.65 ± 3.36 (Perplexity Pro); FRES 37.50 to 52.59.
links.quote: However, all models produced responses above the recommended sixth-grade readability level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of LLM-generated patient education responses
links.effect: All four LLMs exceeded the sixth-grade readability level; mean FKGL 12.65 to 15.65, FRES 37.50 to 52.59, indicating difficult text.
links.quote: However, all models produced responses above the recommended sixth-grade readability level.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on reliability, quality, and readability for patient-oriented oral cancer questions without testing any deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
